qualification.details: Educational qualification requirements for SINP Recruitment 2026 vary by post. A summary of the essential qualification for each post is given below; candidates should verify the complete desirable qualifications and experience requirements in the official notification.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates for SINP Recruitment 2026 will be placed in the following pay levels as per the 7th CPC, along with D.A., H.R.A., and other allowances as per Institute rules.

selection_process: The selection process for SINP Recruitment 2026 differs by post category:

Scientist 'C' (all posts): Interview; a qualifying-nature written test may also be conducted. Final merit list is prepared from Interview marks only. Scientific Assistant 'B' and Technician 'B' (all posts): Phase I - Written Test (qualifying); Phase II - Trade Test. Final merit list is prepared from Trade Test marks only. Assistant Administrative Officer-I: Written exam and perusal of APAR. Lower Division Clerk: Phase I - Written Test; Phase II - Typing Skill Test (qualifying). Final merit list is prepared from Written Test marks only

among candidates who qualify Phase II. Security Guard A: Phase I - Physical Fitness Test (qualifying); Phase II - Written Test. Final merit list is prepared from Written Test marks only. Work Assistant 'A': MCQ-based Written Test. Merit list prepared from Written Test marks. Halwai-cum-Cook: Phase I - Written Test (qualifying); Phase II - Cooking Skill Test. Final merit list prepared from Skill Test marks only.
how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online for SINP Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:
Visit the official SINP job opportunities portal at https://www.saha.ac.in/web/job-opportunities.
Pay the requisite application fee online first (if not exempted), as the transaction reference number is needed while filling the form.
Register and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and post-related details.
Upload scanned copies of the required documents, photograph, and signature.
Submit the online application before 15.09.2026 (3:00 PM IST) and save the completed form as a PDF.

Email the saved PDF application (single file, renamed as "Post Code_Application No.") along with supporting documents to [email protected], mentioning the candidate's name and post name in the subject line, before 18.09.2026 (3:00 PM IST).

Candidates applying through proper channel or for the Deputation post must additionally send a hard copy/printout of the submitted application, duly signed, to The Registrar, Registrar's Office, Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics, 1/AF, Bidhannagar, Kolkata-700064, by 28.09.2026.
Keep a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post, with fee (if applicable) and documents. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances; fee paid other than by online remittance will not be accepted. Candidates employed in Government/Quasi-Government/Autonomous Institutes/PSUs must apply through proper channel with a Vigilance Clearance forwarding letter. Applications without requisite fee, without supporting documents, or received after the due date will be treated as "REJECTED". No correspondence regarding selection/test/interview/appointment will be entertained; canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate. All future correspondence during the selection process will be made through email and/or post - candidates must mention a correct, active email address. SINP reserves the right to fill up or not fill up the posts. Any amendments/modifications will be notified only on the official SINP website.

Candidates who have completed their postgraduate degree in life sciences can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and M.Sc Life Sciences Jobs available across India. Applicants searching for openings closer to the NCR region can check Faridabad Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. content_sections.heading: SINP Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SINP has announced a total of 62 vacancies across three categories - Scientific, Technical, and Administrative & Auxiliary (including Canteen). Category-wise reservation (UR/SC/OBC-NCL/EWS) is shown in parentheses against each post. All 5 Scientist 'C' posts together are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) on a horizontal basis: 1 post for blindness/low vision, 1 for deaf and hard of hearing, 2 for locomotor disability, and 1 for multiple disabilities/autism/intellectual disability, as notified under DoPT O.M. No. 36035/02/2017-Estt (Res) dated 15.01.2018. Scientific Assistant 'B' posts total 8 vacancies, of which 1 is reserved for PwBD (category c: locomotor disability). Technician 'B' posts total 18 vacancies. Out of the 7 LDC vacancies, 1 is reserved for PwBD. Out of the 8 Security Guard A vacancies, 4 are reserved for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q1. What is SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SINP Recruitment 2026 is a notification released by Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics, Kolkata (Advt. No. SINP/Estt./Advt./11/2026), for 62 vacancies across Scientist 'C', Scientific Assistant 'B', Technician 'B', AAO-I, LDC, Security Guard A, Work Assistant 'A', and Halwai-cum-Cook posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 62 vacancies are available: 5 Scientist 'C', 8 Scientific Assistant 'B', 18 Technician 'B', 1 AAO-I, 7 LDC, 8 Security Guard A, 11 Work Assistant 'A', and 4 Halwai-cum-Cook.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 15.09.2026 (3:00 PM IST). The PDF application must reach SINP by email by 18.09.2026 (3:00 PM IST).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from 10th pass with a Diploma in Catering (Halwai-cum-Cook) to an M.Sc in Physics/Applied Physics/Optics/Electronics (Scientist 'C'). See the Eligibility Criteria section above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit ranges from 25 years (Technician 'B', Halwai-cum-Cook) to 33 years (Scientist 'C'), with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for Scientist 'C' and Scientific Assistant 'B' posts, and Rs. 300 for all other posts. Women, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and Deputation candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official SINP job opportunities portal at saha.ac.in, fill the application form, upload the required documents, and submit before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SINP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process differs by post - it includes Interview (Scientist 'C'), Written Test + Trade Test (Scientific Assistant 'B'/Technician 'B'), Written Test + Skill Test (LDC, Halwai-cum-Cook), Physical Fitness Test + Written Test (Security Guard A), MCQ Written Test (Work Assistant 'A'), and Written Exam + APAR review (AAO-I).

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for SINP Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level 1 (Security Guard A, Work Assistant 'A') to Level 10 (Scientist 'C') as per the 7th CPC pay matrix, along with D.A., H.R.A., and other allowances as per Institute rules.

faq.question: Q10. Is SINP Recruitment 2026 open to candidates from outside West Bengal?
faq.answer: The notification does not restrict the recruitment to any particular state; eligible candidates from across India meeting the qualification, age, and other criteria for each post can apply.
